recipes.name: Ultra Fudgy Sea Salt Caramel Brownies
instructions: Line a 9 x 9 inch (21 x 21 cm) baking dish. Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
In a food processor, blend the dates, coconut oil, cocoa powder, and water until smooth**.
Add the pecans, chocolate, and salt. Blend again, but let some chunks remain.
Transfer the mixture into the prepared baking dish, and spread evenly. Bake for 10 minutes***.
When removed from the oven, top with some more crushed pecans, chopped chocolate, and a sprinkle of sea salt if desired. Gently press these in to secure them.
Let cool before cutting. These brownies are fudgiest if kept in the fridge. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. Using refined coconut oil is preferred to unrefined as the brownies retain a more neutral flavour. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** You may need to add more water if the dates are dry to achieve a caramel-like mixture. Alternatively, if you don't have a food processor, mash the dates with a fork and mix the ingredients in a bowl. *** Alternatively, skip the baking and put them straight into the fridge for chewy no-bake brownies.
Storage Store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 4 days, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.
